title: Shared Schelling Points: Do Independent Models Coordinate on the Same Hidden Choice?

original_idea.body: Run Schelling-coordination prompts across open models; measure shared focal points vs humans.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tacit cross-model coordination is a recognized multi-agent collusion risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: simple Schelling prompts + agreement stats, public human baselines.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment with clear focal-agreement metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected gold: model-organism study of a fuzzy multi-agent capability.

low_compute.reasoning: Short prompts, light inference; near free-tier feasible.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-model Schelling-point convergence seems mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No direct work on shared Schelling points across models known.
